detail: CI workflow gates PRs with Node 18/20/22 matrix (minimum supported, current LTS, active release). Publish workflow triggers on v* tags with npm provenance attestations and auto-generated GitHub Releases. POSTHOG_API_KEY is injected only during publish builds. workflow_dispatch with dry-run option enables testing the pipeline without publishing. Tests re-run in publish as defense-in-depth since tag pushes bypass PR CI.
summary: Add CI (build-and-test on PRs) and Publish (npm publish on tags) GitHub Actions workflows
